title: Affine schemes are quasi-compact and quasi-separated
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme, i.e. a scheme [def-pc-scheme] isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}A$ for a commutative ring $A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $X$ is quasi-compact (its underlying topological space is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]) and quasi-separated ($X\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ is quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]; equivalently the intersection of two quasi-compact open subsets of $X$ is quasi-compact).
